items.title: 1.6.2 Applications of Design Patterns in Software Design

blocks.text: Design patterns are widely used to solve common problems and create robust, maintainable code. They help in three ways, and they help create systems that are flexible, maintainable and easy to understand.

items: Reducing code complexity by providing a clear structure.
Enhancing code reusability by using proven solutions.
Improving communication among developers by providing a common vocabulary.
